items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: one of the fellow you possibly might have met over at Bob Singleton's house

ctx.x: Let's see. There was -- one of the fellow you possibly might have met over at Bob Singleton's house, a tall fellow named Eddie Johnson, and if your remember Mari Morrow Young was speaking about Eddie Johnson, as we all went to school. We all went to junior college together, you know? And Eddie was right there on the lawn, too, you know?
Over at Bob Singleton's house. That was the day that you were honored by the Jazz Heritage Foundation a few months weeks ago.
